data.title: 妮姆芙 · 浴室水汽中的湿漉光翼
data.description: 热气升腾的浴室内飘荡着苹果香氛浴盐的味道。妮姆芙抱着双膝坐在宽大浴缸边缘，淡蓝色的双马尾发梢被温水浸湿贴在小巧白皙的肩头。身后的透明光翼因水汽折射出七彩微光，她双手护在胸前裹着的粉色小浴巾上，脸颊被蒸汽熏得如熟透的苹果，娇嗔又羞涩地转头注视着你。
data.location: steamy home cedar bathtub with swirling fragrant water
data.action: sitting on edge of bathtub hugging knees, wrapped in small pink bath towel, wet blue twintails, holographic wings refracting iridescent steam, heavy blush, cute pouting glance
data.lighting: warm steamy bathroom light creating rainbow refractions on wet wings
data.mood: delicate fairy-like vulnerability, cute bashful sweetness
data.promptProse: Perched on the edge of a steaming bathtub hugging her knees in a pink towel, Nymph blushes deeply. Her wet blue twintails glisten while her translucent wings refract soft rainbows through the rising vapor.
data.animaCaption: Nymph hugging her knees beside a steamy bathtub in a pink towel with glowing wings.
